title: The stationary localized-cardinal family has an explicit strict upper-coefficient envelope

upper_coefficient.scalar_input: Let j_R(t) be K1676's exact Rademacher--Gaussian relative Fisher information.
upper_coefficient.functional: Define h_g^card-up=h_g^prof+inf_(C,t){(j_R(t)/4)tau_g(C)-2g t^2 ell_g(C)}, over K1683 fixed admissible rectangular blocks C and 0<t<1.
upper_coefficient.finite_cutoff_recovery: For each fixed C and t, the K1678 product trial and translation-Haar averaging give limsup_N [Q_N-lambda_N^statG]/N^4 <= (j_R(t)/4)tau_g(C)-2g t^2 ell_g(C).
upper_coefficient.strictness: Because j_R(t)=(2/3)t^4+O(t^5) while ell_g(C)>0, every fixed admissible C has a sufficiently small t with a negative bracket. Therefore limsup_N E_N/N^4<=h_g^card-up<h_g^prof.
upper_coefficient.local_surrogate: For fixed C the weak-channel surrogate is (tau_g(C)/6)t^4-2g ell_g(C)t^2; its formal interior optimizer has t^2=6g ell_g(C)/tau_g(C) and improvement -6g^2 ell_g(C)^2/tau_g(C), only when that optimizer lies in the controlled weak regime.
upper_coefficient.scope_guard: The functional is an explicit variational upper envelope for fixed-shape Rademacher-cardinal trials. Haar averaging may lower Fisher further. This is not the true unrestricted coefficient, a matching lower bound, an optimal shape, a minimizer, an E_N+O(1) recentering or a continuum state.
